title: EFV-8 Mars
extract:
EFV-8 Mars is a  Scaldra pistol used by Scaldra Barbicans. Shoots semi-automatic rounds with its primary fire, while its Alternate Fire launches a  Corrosive grenade.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Puncture damage on its primary fire and pure  Corrosive on its Alternate Fire.
Alternate Fire charges to release a grenade that explodes in a 3 meter radius.
Initial hit and explosion apply status separately.
Explosion has a guaranteed  Corrosive proc.
Explosion does not need direct line of sight to deal damage and will penetrate walls.
Does not inflict self-stagger.
Consumes 3 ammo per shot.
Can benefit from  Fulmination ( Primed).
Innate  and  polarities.

Acquisition
EFV-8 Mars's blueprints can be purchased from Minerva of  The Hex for  Standing; component blueprints for  5,000 each, and the main blueprint for  15,000 to a total of  30,000, all requiring Rank 5 - Pizza Party.
This weapon is also part of the Scaldra Dominance Pack for  655.

Notes
Cannot equip  Semi-Pistol Cannonade due to the charged shot.

Tips

Trivia
The EFV-8 Mars appears to be heavily inspired by the Russian TOZ-81 Mars pistol, which is (similarly) a top-break revolver with a cylinder pushed far to the back of the weapon.
This is the TOZ-81 Mars' second known appearance in fictional media, after it was added to the VR game "Hot Dogs, Horseshoes & Hand Grenades" in December 2022.
Despite sharing the 5-round cylinder with the TOZ-81 Mars it possesses a 15-round magazine capacity. It also erroneously ejects spent cartridges when fired.
Mars is the 4th planet in the Solar System and named after the Roman God of war.
The Höllvanian text on the gun reads "5.45 39 M." (5.45x39mm), "MAWDUHL-98 EHN 170001" (Model-98 N 170001), "FV-8 MAWRZ" (FV-8 Mars), "LACH" (Latch), and "OOAHRNIHNG TAWKSIHK IHLEHKTRIHK HAZAWRD" (WARNING TOXIC ELECTRIC HAZARD).
The cylinders are also numbered 1-5.
The bottle below the the gun appears to list the ingredients for Efervon. It reads:

Oddly, this implies the Scaldra use modern Infested parts for creating Efervon, thought they would have no way to obtain them.
Vanadium Pentide possibly refers to Vanadium Pentoxide, a real chemical.
Unlike other revolvers in Warframe such as the  Vasto or Protokol 95 Pistol Skin the cylinder does not fully rotate, instead immediately snapping to the second chamber before rotating back to the first. If fired fast enough it will simply stay on the second chamber, appearing static until the trigger is released.
